unlisted_practices: Explore measures to mitigate the dangers of misinformation from generative AI.
Increase digital training opportunities for the general public from validated sources.
Psychiatrists should recognise that patients may obtain misinformation online, including about medicine and psychiatry, and make decisions based on generative AI responses.
